edges.reason: constructor uses _msgSender() as owner, initial reflection holder and fee-exempt address
transfer passes _msgSender() as the from address
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender
caller-controlled sender flows into _transfer through transfer/transferFrom
onlyOwner modifier requires _owner == _msgSender() in setTrading
manualswap gates execution on msg.sender being the development or marketing address
manualsend gates execution on msg.sender being the development or marketing address
blockBots is protected by onlyOwner (msg.sender check)
unblockBot is protected by onlyOwner (msg.sender check)
setFee is onlyOwner and can arbitrarily reset all fee percentages
setMinSwapTokensThreshold is onlyOwner
toggleSwap is onlyOwner
setMaxTxnAmount is onlyOwner
setMaxWalletSize is onlyOwner
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is onlyOwner
block.timestamp is used as the Uniswap swap deadline, making execution time-dependent
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap with the computed token amount
swapTokensForEth reads the stored uniswapV2Router
swapTokensForEth approves the router to spend contract tokens (writes _allowances)
lockTheSwap toggles inSwap around the external router call
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when contract balance exceeds the threshold
_transfer forwards swapped ETH through sendETHToFee
sendETHToFee sends the whole amount to _marketingAddress
sendETHToFee performs the external ETH transfer to the marketing address
external ETH send to the marketing address can re-enter the token transfer flow
a contract marketing address can re-enter manualsend/sendETHToFee and drain contract ETH
the external router call triggers token transfers that can re-enter _transfer; the inSwap flag only protects swapTokensForEth
_transfer delegates the actual balance math to _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer removes fees when takeFee is false
_tokenTransfer restores fees after the transfer completes
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to move reflection balances
_transferStandard obtains fee and reflection values from _getValues
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the tax portion
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the redistribution portion
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances in _rOwned
_takeTeam credits the team reflection amount to _rOwned[address(this)]
_reflectFee permanently reduces _rTotal
_reflectFee increases the accumulated _tFeeTotal
_getValues calls _getTValues with the active fees
_getValues calls _getRValues with the rate
_getValues obtains the current rate through _getRate
reflection amounts stem from tAmount.mul(currentRate) arithmetic and feed _transferStandard state updates
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount <= _rTotal before dividing
tokenFromReflection obtains currentRate from _getRate
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply to fetch supplies
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply
balanceOf converts the stored reflection balance through tokenFromReflection
balanceOf reads the caller's reflection balance from _rOwned
transferFrom decreases the stored allowance in _allowances
_approve writes the new allowance into _allowances
constructor assigns the whole _rTotal to _rOwned[msg.sender]
constructor initialises the uniswapV2Router state variable
constructor stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair
constructor performs the external factory.createPair call
the address returned by createPair becomes uniswapV2Pair
constructor marks owner, contract, development and marketing addresses as fee exempt
setTrading flips the tradingOpen flag
_transfer gates non-owner transfers on tradingOpen
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for sender and recipient

unblockBot writes false into the bots mapping

_transfer enforces the _maxWalletSize limit
setMaxWalletSize updates _maxWalletSize
_transfer checks the swapEnabled flag before swapping
toggleSwap updates swapEnabled
_transfer compares the contract balance against _swapTokensAtAmount

_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee applicability

_transfer selects _redisFeeOnBuy/_redisFeeOnSell into _redisFee
_transfer selects _taxFeeOnBuy/_taxFeeOnSell into _taxFee

removeAllFee zeroes the active tax fee

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is the amount destination parameter of the ERC20 transfer entry point
amount is the value parameter of the ERC20 transfer entry point
spender is the approval target parameter of approve
amount is the allowance value parameter of approve
sender is the debited address parameter of transferFrom
recipient is the credited address parameter of transferFrom
amount is both moved and subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom
from is the source address parameter that drives limit and blacklist checks
to is the destination address parameter checked against the pair and wallet size
amount is the value parameter validated against _maxTxAmount
tokenAmount is approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth
amount is the ETH value forwarded to the marketing address
_tradingOpen is the flag parameter written to tradingOpen
bots_ is the address array parameter blacklisted by blockBots
notbot is the address parameter cleared from the blacklist
sender is the source parameter passed into the transfer math
recipient is the destination parameter passed into the transfer math
amount is the value parameter passed into the transfer math
takeFee decides whether removeAllFee/restoreAllFee wrap the transfer
tAmount is the token amount decomposed by _getValues
tTeam is the team fee credited to the contract reflection balance
rFee is the reflection amount subtracted from _rTotal
tFee is the token fee added to _tFeeTotal
redisFee scales the redistribution portion of the token value math
taxFee scales the team portion of the token value math
redisFeeOnBuy is written into the buy redistribution fee state variable
redisFeeOnSell is written into the sell redistribution fee state variable
taxFeeOnBuy is written into the buy tax fee state variable
taxFeeOnSell is written into the sell tax fee state variable
maxTxAmount overwrites the _maxTxAmount state variable
maxWalletSize overwrites the _maxWalletSize state variable
accounts is the looped array of addresses whose fee status changes
excluded is the boolean stored for every account in the loop
rAmount is the bounded reflection value divided by the current rate
account is the mapping key used to read the reflection balance
owner is the outer mapping key used in the allowance view
spender is the inner mapping key used in the allowance view
contractTokenBalance is a temporary cache of the contract balance inside _transfer
canSwap is the local boolean gating the automatic swap branch
takeFee is the local flag passed from _transfer to _tokenTransfer
path is the local swap path array consumed by the router call
contractETHBalance is the local ETH balance forwarded to sendETHToFee
currentRate is the local divisor used to convert the reflection amount
tTeam is the local team fee returned from _getValues and passed to _takeTeam
contractBalance is the local token balance swapped by manualswap
contractETHBalance is the local ETH balance sent by manualsend
i is the loop counter iterating over the bots_ array
currentRate is the local rate used by the reflection value computation
